question: What share of the 0.1C reversible capacity is retained at 1C?
expect: 370 of ~700 mAh/gS: over 50% (the paper's words), ~53% computed (p5.L86-88)
trap: a share of the theoretical capacity
rendered: According to the text, at 0.1C, a reversible capacity of >700 mAh/gS is measured. At 1C, a capacity of >300 mAh/gS is maintained. Therefore, the share of the 0.1C reversible capacity that is retained at 1C is approximately 300/700 = 0.43 or 43%.
